summary: Remove three parked and unreferenced public assets identified by F-033 so they are no longer copied into the production build.

impactAnalysis.notes: Full-system review confirms indoor_plants2.glb, bar_chair2.glb and exhibition-floor.jpg are parked/unreferenced production payload. Their removal does not change catalog, runtime renderer selection, module state, placement or persistence. The active exhibition-floor-optimized.jpg remains present. The existing parked-indoor-plant regression is updated to lock the new removal decision, and browser smoke coverage verifies the application still boots after the asset cleanup.

e2e.reason: The change removes public production assets; browser smoke coverage verifies the built application still loads while the active optimized floor texture remains available.

risk.notes: The three deleted files were classified by the audit as inactive runtime inputs. Risk is limited to an overlooked reference, which is covered by full tests, build and browser smoke verification.

migration.notes: No saved project schema, IndexedDB data or import/export format changes are involved.

rollback: Restore the three deleted public assets from the parent ROG commit and revert the F-033 asset-presence regression expectation.
